def is_blank(value):

        return value.replace("\xa0", " ").strip()
    if isinstance(value, float) and value.is_integer():
        return str(int(value))
    return str(value)

def suffix_to_number(suffix):
    n = 0
    for ch in suffix.lower():
        if "a" <= ch <= "z":
            n = n * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord("a") + 1)
        else:
            return None
    return n

def number_to_suffix(n):

    while n > 0:
        n -= 1

        n //= 26
    return "".join(reversed(chars))

        current_suffix_count = 0
        continue

    # and advance the suffix count so later blanks continue as 5b / 5ab, etc.
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)([A-Za-z]+)", text)

        suffix_num = suffix_to_number(m.group(2))
